# --- COMMON HARDENING START (DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY) ---
ARG CACHEBUST=1
RUN echo "Cache bust: $CACHEBUST" && \
    export PATH="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin:$PATH" && \
    if command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
        echo "⛰️ Alpine Linux detected" && \
        (apk update || echo "⚠️ apk update failed") && \
        (apk upgrade --no-cache || echo "⚠️ apk upgrade failed") && \
        for pkg in zlib sqlite-libs libcrypto3 libssl3; do \
            if apk add --no-cache --upgrade "$pkg" > /tmp/pkg_out 2> /tmp/pkg_err; then \
                echo "✅ Successfully upgraded $pkg"; \
            else \
                echo "⚠️ Failed to upgrade $pkg. Error:"; \
                cat /tmp/pkg_err || true; \
            fi; \
        done && \
        (apk del --no-cache nano vim git || true) && \
        rm -rf /var/cache/apk/* /usr/share/man/* /tmp/pkg_* || true; \
    elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
        echo "🌀 Debian/Ubuntu detected" && \
        export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && \
        (apt-get update -o Acquire::Retries=3 || echo "⚠️ apt-get update failed") && \
        (apt-get upgrade -y -o Acquire::Retries=3 || echo "⚠️ apt-get upgrade failed") && \
        echo "🔒 Installing critical security updates..." && \
        for pkg in libc6 zlib1g libsqlite3-0 openssl ca-certificates; do \
            if apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends --only-upgrade "$pkg" > /tmp/pkg_out 2> /tmp/pkg_err; then \
                echo "✅ Successfully upgraded $pkg"; \
            else \
                echo "⚠️ Failed to upgrade $pkg. Error:"; \
                cat /tmp/pkg_err || true; \
            fi; \
        done && \
        (apt-get purge -y --auto-remove vim nano git telnet ftp man-db doc-debian 2>/dev/null || true) && \
        apt-get clean && \
        rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /tmp/* /var/tmp/* /usr/share/doc/* /usr/share/man/* || true; \
    else \
        echo "⚠️ No supported package manager. Skipping." && true; \
    fi && \
    echo "📦 Upgrading Language Packages for Vulnerability Remediation..." && \
    (if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
        for pkg in tar glob systeminformation; do \
            if [ -d /usr/src/app ] && [ -f /usr/src/app/package.json ]; then \
                if cd /usr/src/app && npm update "$pkg" > /tmp/pkg_out 2> /tmp/pkg_err; then \
                    echo "✅ Successfully updated npm package $pkg"; \
                else \
                    echo "⚠️ Failed to update npm package $pkg. Error:"; \
                    cat /tmp/pkg_err || true; \
                fi; \
            else \
                if npm install -g "$pkg" > /tmp/pkg_out 2> /tmp/pkg_err; then \
                    echo "✅ Successfully updated npm package $pkg"; \
                else \
                    echo "⚠️ Failed to update npm package $pkg. Error:"; \
                    cat /tmp/pkg_err || true; \
                fi; \
            fi; \
        done; \
    fi) && \
    (if command -v pip >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v pip3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
        PIP_CMD=$(command -v pip || command -v pip3); \
        for pkg in wheel urllib3 python-multipart jaraco.context; do \
            if $PIP_CMD install --upgrade --no-cache-dir "$pkg" > /tmp/pkg_out 2> /tmp/pkg_err; then \
                echo "✅ Successfully updated pip package $pkg"; \
            else \
                echo "⚠️ Failed to update pip package $pkg. Error:"; \
                cat /tmp/pkg_err || true; \
            fi; \
        done; \
    fi) && \
    echo "🧹 Optimizing Docker layers for Trivy scanning..." && \
    (find /var/lib/dpkg -type f -name "*-old" -delete 2>/dev/null || true) && \
    (find /var/lib/apt/lists -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true) && \
    (rm -rf /usr/share/doc/* /usr/share/man/* /usr/share/info/* /var/cache/debconf/* 2>/dev/null || true)
# --- COMMON HARDENING END ---
